_meta.purpose: Single diagnosis and recommendation catalogue shared by prediction and application integration.

entries.observablePattern: Fuel level declines below 20 percent and continues toward the critical reserve.
probableCauses: Day tank not replenished after testing

correctiveActions.action: Confirm the fuel reading against the local tank gauge.
Refill the day tank before the critical reserve is reached.
Inspect the supply line, valves and tank for restriction or leakage.
Record the refill and update the refuelling schedule.

entries.observablePattern: Room temperature rises during sustained operation with increasing current imbalance.

correctiveActions.action: Reduce nonessential generator load.
Inspect ventilation openings and cooling fans.
Check coolant level and radiator condition after safe shutdown.
Do not return to full load until temperature stabilises.

entries.observablePattern: Phase-voltage spread and frequency deviation increase before generator output becomes unstable.

correctiveActions.action: Isolate nonessential load.
Verify phase voltages and frequency with an approved meter.
Inspect AVR, governor response and phase connections.
Keep the generator isolated if output remains outside limits.

entries.observablePattern: The generator controller reports a general fault or fail-to-start condition.

correctiveActions.action: Read and record the generator-controller fault code.
Check emergency-stop and protection interlocks.
Inspect the starting battery and starter circuit.
Reset only after the recorded cause is corrected.

entries.observablePattern: Mains is unavailable and generator voltage is present, but source transfer is not completed.

correctiveActions.action: Confirm mains loss and stable generator voltage.
Check emergency-stop and ATS control interlocks.
Inspect transfer actuator and control relays.
Perform authorised manual transfer if automatic transfer remains unavailable.

entries.observablePattern: ATS mains input voltage is outside the configured operating range.

correctiveActions.action: Verify all incoming phases with an approved meter.
Inspect incoming terminals and voltage-sensing connections.
Confirm the ATS transfers to the alternate source when required.

entries.observablePattern: One phase drifts while phase-current imbalance and cabinet temperature increase.

correctiveActions.action: Measure and record all phase currents.
Redistribute single-phase loads where practical.
Inspect terminals for heating or discoloration.
Torque connections to the approved specification during isolation.

entries.observablePattern: All MDP incoming phases collapse following loss of the upstream ATS output.

correctiveActions.action: Confirm the ATS output and upstream breaker state.
Restore the upstream source before investigating downstream panels.
Verify all MDP phases before re-energising loads.

entries.observablePattern: Current and temperature rise before the local breaker opens and phase voltage falls.

correctiveActions.action: Keep the tripped breaker open.
Isolate downstream circuits and identify the affected feeder.
Inspect load, cabling and protection coordination.
Reset only after the cause is removed and insulation checks pass.

entries.correlationRule: When an upstream ATS or MDP supply alarm is active, resolve SDP_PHASE_VOLTAGE as SDP_SUPPLY_LOSS instead.

entries.observablePattern: All SDP phases collapse while an upstream ATS or MDP supply alarm is active.

correctiveActions.action: Confirm the related upstream alarm.
Restore ATS and MDP supply first.
Verify all SDP phases before restoring downstream loads.

entries.observablePattern: UPS input voltage disappears and the unit changes to battery operation.

correctiveActions.action: Confirm whether an ATS transfer is in progress.
Check the upstream source and breaker state.
Restore input power before battery runtime is exhausted.
Shed nonessential load if restoration will be delayed.

entries.correlationRule: Suppress during a successful ATS source transfer; activate if input power remains absent after the transfer window.

entries.observablePattern: Runtime and battery voltage decline faster than expected during discharge.

correctiveActions.action: Record charge, voltage, runtime and discharge rate.
Run a controlled battery test.
Inspect individual battery modules and connections.
Replace the weak battery string and verify recharge performance.

entries.observablePattern: Load rises above the operating limit while temperature increases and runtime falls.

correctiveActions.action: Identify and remove noncritical load.
Verify the connected equipment against the UPS rating.
Redistribute load between available UPS units.
Confirm load and temperature return to the normal range.

entries.observablePattern: The UPS reports a general internal operational fault.

correctiveActions.action: Record the UPS display fault code and operating mode.
Confirm whether the protected load remains supplied.
Transfer to an approved alternate supply if required.
Follow the manufacturer fault-code procedure before reset.

entries.observablePattern: The digital fire-alarm input changes to the active state without a dependable telemetry precursor.
probableCauses: Heat or smoke in the monitored room

correctiveActions.action: Follow the site emergency response procedure immediately.
Notify the control centre and emergency response team.
Isolate electrical power only when authorised.
Verify and document the affected room after it is declared safe.

entries.observablePattern: The digital intrusion input changes to the active state without a telemetry precursor.

correctiveActions.action: Verify access records and camera coverage.
Dispatch authorised security staff.
Inspect the access sensor after the area is secured.
Record the event and resolution.
